verdict.rationale: First-party support docs confirm the undo half of the story: you have a short window after sending to retract a message by clicking Undo. Nothing in the pack documents scheduling a message to send later; snooze applies only to received mail, so it does not count. missing for 10: evidence of a schedule-send capability, documentation of how long the undo grace window lasts or whether it can be configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.
